description: Schema for aco_price_books — ACO price book hierarchy (camelCase only). Root priceBookId is the Commerce website code. Child priceBookId is websiteCode, two colons, and the SHA-1 of the customer group id: the id Commerce's commerceOptimizer query answers. A pack from another source may name its books differently. currency is required only on root rows (no parentId).

parentId.description: Parent price book id (website code) when this row is a child

currency.description: ISO 4217 — required on root rows only
